newsitem.title: BRAZIL: New Brazil GDP method only affects current account.
newsitem.headline: New Brazil GDP method only affects current account.

text.p: A change in the way the Brazilian Central Bank calculates the dollar value of gross domestic product only affects current account results, said Altamir Lopes, head of the bank's economic department.
"The operational deficit is not affected because that is calculated in reais," Lopes told reporters. He said the balance of payments indicators were the only ones calculated in dollars.
The Central Bank said Friday it had started using the annual average exchange rate instead of the theory of purchasing power parity as a method to determine GDP.
